data.name: LIFE SIM: Rise From Nothing
data.detailed_description:
"Life Sim: Rise from Nothing tells the story of those who start from zero at the market and work hard to reopen a family bakery in ruins—a calm-paced life and business simulation."

🧁 Start from Scratch

Begin earning money by selling fresh fruits and vegetables at the market. Every sale brings you one step closer to your dream.

🏚️ Restore the Bakery

Clean, equip, decorate, and reopen the inherited rundown bakery.

👨‍🍳 Manage Your Team

Hire an expert pastry chef, bring on waiters, and grow your team. Every employee is a helping hand to make your work easier.

🥐 Realistic Product System

A dynamic economy awaits you, with perishable products, fluctuating market prices, and customer demands.

🍽️ Customer Interaction

Sell to customers who stop by your market stall, take orders from seated guests, and pass them on to the kitchen.

🏙️ An Evolving World

Buy new equipment, expand your menu, decorate your bakery, and become the most popular spot in town.

📖 An Emotional Story

Keep your family’s dream alive. Every corner holds a memory, every table has a story.

This is more than just a business—this is your story.

data.short_description: Life Sim: Rise from Nothing is a realistic and peaceful world for those building their dreams from scratch. Start by setting up a stall at the market, sell your products, and save up money. Then, buy the rundown bakery inherited from your family and restore it to its former glory.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 2600 or Intel 8400
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 480 or Gtx 1050ti
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3600x or Intel 10400
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: RX580 or GTX 1070
